summary: UtilityAi uses F2 Q16.16 for every decision. Its private UtilityScore clamps all Fixed inputs into 0..1. Linear, quadratic (F2 nearest/ties-up) and square-root (floor) responses are monotone with exact endpoints; invert yields their exact decreasing complements. Product folds in declared consideration order with rounded Fixed multiplication: empty is 1 and zero vetoes. It deliberately provides no weights or compensation; reassociation/permutation may change the last bit. Choose scans iteratively and keeps the first highest score, including all-zero ties; an empty list gives None. The caller must supply normalized values and deterministic action order. This is an additive LockstepExact source surface, not a claim of canonical IAUS behavior or a released package. Independent integer FsCheck oracles, exhaustive 65,537-point response checks, append-only operation 16 fixtures and 100,000-element Node checks exercise its contract. Timing admission and product-pack distribution remain separately qualified; a kernel registration or compile is not a timing baseline.
title: Bounded Fixed utility responses and stable ordered selection
